title: Beautiful Luxury Home Near 12thS: Top Rated Home
description:
This contemporary home, c. 2017, is well appointed with modern features & finishes. Premium location is just 1 mi from 12 South, 2 mi from Green Hills shopping, 4 mi to The Gulch and downtown Nashville. A quick Lyft ride will have you most anywhere in minutes.

The 3,600 sq ft home has a large primary BR down, flex room down, and three guest BR's up. Enjoy two living areas, full kitchen, dining area, front porch, and back patio.

Beautiful finishes, lux bedding, top location, & lots of space.

The space
This spacious 3,600 sq. ft. home offers a comfortable and stylish stay in one of Nashville’s most convenient locations. The main floor features a large primary bedroom and a versatile flex room, perfect for remote work or extra lounging. Upstairs, guests will find three well-appointed guest bedrooms, ideal for families or groups. Enjoy two inviting living areas, a fully equipped kitchen, a dedicated dining space, and outdoor areas including a welcoming front porch and a private back patio—great for morning coffee or evening unwinding. 

Parking is easy. Guests may park 2 cars on the parking pad in front on the house. If needed, a third parking spot can be used behind the house.

Guest access
Guests have access to all the rooms of the house, including laundry room with washer and dryer.
